title: Wildfires Seen from Air Force Academy Grounds
description:
B-roll from Air Force Academy grounds of wildfires. Also available in high definition.

Shot Sequence:
-Aircraft monument on left side, with smoke in background
-Wide shot of aircraft monuments, smoke in background
-Chapel on left side, smoke in background
-Grassy hill in foreground, mountain in background with only peak visible
over smoke
-On ground shot of center road, white truck entering on left and driving off in
distance
-Tree tops in foreground, smoke covered mountain in background, long shot
of helicopter moving right to left
-Behind shot of 3 observers looking at fire
-Fire trucks parked at facility, helicopter flying right to left
-Helicopter flying into shot from left, exiting on right, smoke billowing from
mountain in background
keywords: U.S. Air Force Academy, Wildfire, USAFA, Colorado Springs, Colo., Coloradofire, High Definition
